channel.title: Ecostruxure IT incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Ecostruxure IT's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: SMS 2FA codes are not sent when signing in on ITE [resolved]
SMS 2FA Login Issue – EcoStruxure IT Expert [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting SMS-based two-factor authentication (2FA) has now been resolved.
Users who were previously unable to log in using SMS as their 2FA method should now be able to access EcoStruxure IT Expert normally.
Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Unable to receive data [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved.
Due to a data migration effort, 1 hour and 51 minutes of data are missing from EcoStruxure IT Expert and EcoStruxure Asset Advisor.

item.title: EcoStruxure IT mobile app push notifications unavailable [resolved]
item.description: We have identified an issue with our mobile app push notifications. The issue caused push notifications on mobile devices to be unavailable. That includes 2FA & alarm push notification
